summary: GitHub/Copilot trust backlash after 'hints' (promotional messages) were added to 1.5 million human-written PR reviews without explicit consent. PR manager acknowledged it was 'the wrong judgement call.'
Optio: Open-source orchestration system that turns tickets into merged PRs using AI coding agents (Claude Code/Codex) in K8s pods. Handles self-healing (auto-resume on CI failure).

Microsoft/GitHub released APM (Agent Package Manager) to manage agent dependencies (plugins, skills, rules) with lockfiles and security audits (scanning for hidden Unicode). Deploys to Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor.
G0: Control layer for AI agents focusing on scan, test, and monitor phases. Includes 'cognitive drift monitoring' and a 'kill switch' for autonomous agents. Specifically mentions OpenClaw support.
Discussion on 'Preventing Agent Hijacking' highlights the identity problem when AI agents call tools, open PRs, or touch production data. Points toward the need for cryptographic identity for agents.
Claude Code 'Code Review' research preview launched for Teams/Enterprise. Multi-agent analysis of full codebase to catch logic errors/security vulnerabilities in GitHub PRs.
